canvas.$description: App canvas background (dark). Contrast: base for text/primary (≥4.5:1).

disabled.$description: Disabled control fill (dark). Contrast: with text/disabled.

tooltip.$description: Tooltip surface (dark). Contrast: with text/on-inverse or on-strong (≥4.5:1).

strong.$description: Strong neutral fill (dark). Contrast: use text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

soft.$description: Soft neutral fill (dark). Uses neutral-800 so it stays distinct from bg/surface (neutral-900). Contrast: with text/primary (≥4.5:1).

soft-hover.$description: Soft neutral hover (dark). Contrast: with text/primary (≥4.5:1).

soft-active.$description: Soft neutral active (dark). Contrast: with text/primary (≥4.5:1).

strong-hover.$description: Strong neutral hover (dark). Neutral strong inverts (50), so hover darkens to 200 — not the chromatic 600 step. Contrast: with text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

strong-active.$description: Strong neutral active (dark). Neutral strong inverts (50), so active darkens to 300 — not the chromatic 700 step. Contrast: with text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

strong.$description: Strong info fill (dark). Contrast: use text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

soft.$description: Soft info fill (dark). Contrast: with text/info (≥4.5:1).

soft-hover.$description: Soft info hover (dark). Contrast: with text/info (≥4.5:1).

soft-active.$description: Soft info active (dark). Contrast: with text/info (≥4.5:1).

strong.$description: Strong success fill (dark). Contrast: use text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

soft.$description: Soft success fill (dark). Contrast: with text/success (≥4.5:1).

soft-hover.$description: Soft success hover (dark). Contrast: with text/success (≥4.5:1).

soft-active.$description: Soft success active (dark). Contrast: with text/success (≥4.5:1).

strong-hover.$description: Strong success hover (dark). Contrast: with text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

strong-active.$description: Strong success active (dark). Contrast: with text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

strong.$description: Strong warning fill (dark). Contrast: use text/on-strong-warning (≥4.5:1).

soft.$description: Soft warning fill (dark). Contrast: with text/warning (≥4.5:1).

soft-hover.$description: Soft warning hover (dark). Contrast: with text/warning (≥4.5:1).

soft-active.$description: Soft warning active (dark). Contrast: with text/warning (≥4.5:1).

strong.$description: Strong danger fill (dark). Contrast: use text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

soft.$description: Soft danger fill (dark). Contrast: with text/danger (≥4.5:1).

soft-hover.$description: Soft danger hover (dark). Contrast: with text/danger (≥4.5:1).

soft-active.$description: Soft danger active (dark). Contrast: with text/danger (≥4.5:1).

strong-hover.$description: Strong danger hover (dark). Contrast: with text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

strong-active.$description: Strong danger active (dark). Contrast: with text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

primary.$description: Primary body text (dark). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on canvas/surface.

tertiary.$description: Tertiary text (dark). Prefer for supporting copy; verify contrast on the actual background rather than assuming AA for small body text.

disabled.$description: Disabled text (dark). Contrast: may be <4.5:1 by design for disabled state.

on-inverse.$description: Text on inverse surfaces (dark). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on tooltip/inverse fills.

link-hover.$description: Link hover text (dark). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on canvas.

on-strong.$description: Text/icons on strong fills (dark). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on strong role fills (not warning).

on-strong-warning.$description: Text on warning strong (dark). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on amber-300 — white fails; this is required.

info.$description: info text and status icons (dark). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on soft info / canvas.

info-hover.$description: Hover state for status-coloured text and link buttons. Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on canvas/surface.

success.$description: success text and status icons (dark). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on soft success / canvas.

success-hover.$description: Hover state for status-coloured text and link buttons. Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on canvas/surface.

warning.$description: warning text and status icons (dark). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on soft warning / canvas.

warning-hover.$description: Hover state for status-coloured text and link buttons. Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on canvas/surface.

danger.$description: danger text and status icons (dark). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on soft danger / canvas.

danger-hover.$description: Hover state for status-coloured text and link buttons. Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on canvas/surface.

disabled.$description: Disabled icon (dark). May be reduced contrast by design.

on-inverse.$description: Icon on inverse (dark). Contrast: ≥3:1 / ≥4.5:1 if conveying meaning.

on-selected.$description: Foreground marks on the selected yellow fill — checkbox ticks, radio dots, icons on selected chrome. Distinct from selected/text, which is label text.

subtle.$description: Decorative trim. The card's fill contrast and shadow carry the container boundary; the outline is not load-bearing. Also table dividers and menu separators. Contrast: exempt from 3:1.

focus.$description: Focus ring color (dark). Contrast: ≥3:1 against background.

bg-hover.$description: Selected hover fill (dark). Contrast: with selected/text ≥4.5:1.

text.$description: Selected label text (dark). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on selected/bg.

field-hover.$description: Selected field hover wash (dark). Contrast: with selected/text ≥4.5:1.
